translations.web: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
translations.bsb: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
translations.kjv: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
translations.asv: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:
